reason: Locate the complete backend quality checklist for the final scoped review.
Verify one pure derivation feeds both normal renderers, no renderer invents selection semantics, and additive JSON remains compatible.
Check command-layer cohesion, existing API/fixture reuse, test placement, and absence of cross-package or sync expansion.
Audit model-fetch degradation, existing warnings, by-hash exit 3, successful vet hits, and no extra retry/request behavior.
Verify deterministic offline success/expected-failure tests, exact request counts, focused compatibility, integration parity, zero dependencies, and the full quality gate.
Verify stdout-only results and no new stdout diagnostics or unnecessary warnings for explicit unknown/tied report states.
Audit unknown, missing, empty, malformed, tied, current-absent, and nullable-base evidence across the complete human and JSON contracts.
Check for duplicated latest/base logic across renderers and confirm existing helpers were neither misused nor needlessly changed.
